description: Tutorial example 1: H2O in a 10 AA box (PBE, 60 Ry, Gamma). SCF at a distorted geometry, then relaxation with damped dynamics, and with L-BFGS (!RDYN OPTIMIZER='LBFGS', Davidson + Pulay mixing).

subs.@PSIDYN@:
STOP=T FRIC=0.02 SAFEORTHO=T
    !AUTO FRIC(-)=0.3 FACT(-)=0.97 FRIC(+)=0.3 FACT(+)=1. MINFRIC=0.02 !END
subs.@RDYN@:
!RDYN STOP=T FRIC=0.05
    !AUTO FRIC(-)=0.3 FACT(-)=0.97 FRIC(+)=0.3 FACT(+)=1. MINFRIC=0.05 !END
  !END
